This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and the coverage achieved by different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>0</sup> to 2<sup>8</sup>. Tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 2<sup>1</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  A dark blue line with circular markers represents “Llama-3B”, starting at approximately 0.26 at x=2<sup>0</sup> and increasing to approximately 0.86 at x=2<sup>8</sup>. A dark green dashed line with triangular markers represents “Llama-3B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.32 at x=2<sup>0</sup> and increasing to approximately 0.91 at x=2<sup>8</sup>. A light blue line with triangular markers represents “Llama-1B”, starting at approximately 0.30 at x=2<sup>0</sup> and increasing to approximately 0.76 at x=2<sup>8</sup>. A light green dashed line with circular markers represents “Llama-1B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.40 at x=2<sup>0</sup> and increasing to approximately 0.84 at x=2<sup>8</sup>.
